chunks: Thus We admitted him to Our grace. He is surely one of the righteous.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God admits someone into His mercy as one of the righteous?
ai.summary: This verse, part of the narrative of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), underscores the Shia emphasis on divine mercy (rahmah) as the ultimate recompense for steadfastness in trials. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept that true righteousness is validated not merely by endurance, but by God's gracious inclusion into His spiritual embrace, a theme frequently cited in Tafsir al-Mizan regarding the interplay between human effort and divine grace.
